notes:
In this example, the "_for-sale" prefix is neither within the root
zone nor would it semantically refer to it. It would signal that the
whole TLD is "for sale". Another way to say describe the "situation"
(as per the table header) that the "_for-sale" prefix resides "at the
zone apex" (of the "example" TLD, in this case), but again, there is
no relation to the root zone.
